title: When the Group Chat Falls
author: Ada Dravenmoor
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
